decisive_items: Alveolar lavage fluid mNGS: Detected TW with sequence number 36543 and abundance 0.43%
Lung puncture biopsy: Positive PAS staining
Chest CT: Multiple nodular and patchy high-density shadows in both lungs, with some foci of solid lesions
response.rationale: Positive PAS staining on lung biopsy and detection of TW (likely fungal) in BAL mNGS strongly indicate fungal pneumonia, whereas R1 is a general diagnosis and R6 is contradicted by negative T-spot.

rejected.why: Bronchoscopy only shows mucus, no specific evidence for acute bronchitis; imaging shows nodular lesions.
Pneumonia is too generic; specific fungal evidence points to a more precise etiology.
History of TB but T-spot negative, mNGS and biopsy support fungal over TB.
